machine: Amstrad CPC 6128 classic, 128 KiB, default RAM configuration

code.purpose: fixed executable and linked SDK; includes measured gap above resident globals

globals.purpose: C data, BSS and initializers; ends before reserved stack and guard

clean_background.boot_use: ZX0 loading bitmap begins at 0x8000; actual linked size is recorded in the build map. Decompressed before load_stage overwrites this buffer; maximum boot payload ends before 0xa700

disk_io_buffer.purpose: CAS IN OPEN 2 KiB buffer, outside CPCtelera firmware workspace (&A6FC-&BFFF) and after the compressed chapter payload ending below &9000; background copy may reuse this RAM after the read

bootstrap.purpose: AMSDOS loads and enters the linked binary; counted in code area
